filings.retrieval.Definition

This class describe filename, dcn (Document Control Number), doc_id (Document ID) and filing_id (Financial Filing ID) to retrieve filings documents through a signed URL.

One of the parameters is required for this class.

Available as lseg.data.content.filings.retrieval.Definition.

Syntax

Definition(
    filename: OptStr = None,
    dcn: OptStr = None,
    doc_id: OptStr = None,
    filing_id: OptStr = None,
)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
filename OptStr No None Filename is the given name of the document which also includes its file type
dcn OptStr No None Document Control Number is an external identifier and an enclosed film-number specific to Edgar documents
doc_id OptStr No None Document ID is a LSEG internal identifier assigned to financial filings documents
filing_id OptStr No None Financial Filing ID is a LSEG internal permanent identifier assigned to each filing document

Methods

get_data

Sends a request to the client file store to retrieve the previously defined data.

get_data(session: Session | None = None) -> TypeData

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.

Returns

TypeData instance.

get_data_async

Sends an asynchronous request to the Data Platform to retrieve the previously defined data.

async get_data_async(
    session: Session | None = None,
    on_response: Callable | None = None,
    closure: str | None = None,
) -> TypeData

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.
on_response Callable | None No None User-defined callback function to process the retrieved data.
closure str | None No None Closure parameters that will be returned with the response

Returns

TypeData instance

Example

from lseg.data.content import filings
definition = filings.retrieval.Definition(filename="ecpfilings_34359955599_pdf")
response = definition.get_data()
response.data.files[0].download(path="C:\Downloads\download_test")

# Download all files at once

response.data.files.download(path="C:\Downloads\download_test")
